{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
'''Melahnese''' was a type of exotic cuisine from the [[Melahna system/Legends|Melahna system]] that was served in a restaurant in the [[Rec Deck food court]] in the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. It was considered expensive to eat. One spicy dish was [[fodu]] in [[green fire sauce]].<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>
